data.body_html:
Planning a marbella yacht charter vegan catering 2031 experience means you can enjoy the Costa del Sol without compromising your plant-based lifestyle. Whether you’re celebrating a milestone or simply soaking up the sun off Puerto Banús, our fleet of 17 boats can accommodate vegan menus, gluten-free options, and other dietary needs. From the compact Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) to the luxurious Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA. This guide covers menu options, boat recommendations, and booking tips to make your day on the water seamless and delicious.

Vegan Catering Options on Your Marbella Yacht Charter

Our standard inclusions on every charter — water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks — are not automatically vegan. However, we can substitute these with plant-based alternatives at no extra administrative fee. For a full vegan menu, we work with local caterers in Marbella and Puerto Banús who specialise in fresh, seasonal dishes. Expect options like chickpea and spinach stew, grilled vegetable platters, quinoa salads, fresh fruit, and vegan tapas. Prices for a tailored vegan menu typically range from €15 to €25 per person, depending on the number of courses and ingredients. This is arranged at cost, so you only pay for what you eat.

Which Boats in Our Fleet Work Best for Vegan Groups?

All our boats can accommodate vegan catering, but space and capacity vary. For a group of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, departs Puerto Banús) offers a large flybridge and aft deck perfect for al fresco dining. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) is another excellent choice with a spacious saloon. For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are budget-friendly Tier A options starting at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full day (8 hours), including skipper and drinks. The Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) and Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) are also popular for intimate gatherings. If you need a jet ski included, the Mangusta 80 (Tier B, from €4,719/4h) comes with one free.

Dietary Restrictions Beyond Vegan: Gluten-Free, Allergies, and More

We regularly accommodate gluten-free, nut-free, dairy-free, and other allergy requirements. Our standard snacks (crisps, nuts, biscuits) may contain allergens, so we strongly recommend ordering a custom menu. For example, a gluten-free vegan platter might include rice crackers, hummus, vegetable sticks, and fresh fruit. All catering is prepared in kitchens that can be cross-contaminated, so please inform us of severe allergies at booking. We’ll coordinate with caterers who can guarantee allergen-free preparation. For last-minute bookings (less than 48 hours), vegan options may be limited to fruit and pre-packaged items, so plan ahead.

Top Vegan-Friendly Destinations from Puerto Banús

Your skipper can tailor the itinerary to include scenic anchorages with calm waters for swimming and sunbathing. Vegan-friendly spots near Marbella include:

  • Cala del Faro – a quiet cove with crystal-clear water, ideal for a picnic lunch.
  • Cala Cortés – a pebble beach surrounded by cliffs, perfect for snorkelling.
  • Cabopino – a sandy beach with dunes and a nearby chiringuito that can serve vegan options.
  • Estepona coast – longer cruises (approx. 1 hour) offer views of the Sierra Bermeja mountains.

Most itineraries last 4–8 hours, giving you plenty of time to swim, eat, and relax. Your skipper will advise on weather and sea conditions on the day.

How to Book a Vegan Catering Yacht Charter in Marbella

Booking is straightforward via our WhatsApp line. Simply tell us your preferred date, number of guests, dietary requirements, and budget. For standard Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), rates are fixed at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. All other boats are priced on request. We recommend booking at least 7–14 days in advance to secure your preferred vegan menu. On the day, your licensed skipper will welcome you at Puerto Banús and ensure everything runs smoothly. For more details on our full fleet and pricing, visit our [Marbella yacht charter guide](/).
